decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the graduated-orange strapline treatment, along with the selected GLOBAL and DOUGH colours, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Changing the strapline colour treatment does not alter the approved letterform shapes or features.
The source specifies the strapline's colour but does not change the requirement to include the existing strapline.
The selected strapline colour does not change the flame-based O or its recognition requirement.
The same source already establishes rev8-11 as the composition baseline; the strapline colour detail does not require changing that baseline attribute.
The explicit graduated-orange strapline treatment does not change the existing direction to add restrained visual character.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY documenting graduated orange for GLOBAL and the strapline and black for DOUGH.
The final strapline colour selection does not alter the historical concept-development obligations.
The colour treatment does not change the company name, excluded word, or broader-business representation.
Selecting a strapline colour does not itself change the requirement for readability and versatility across applications.
The strapline colour choice has no necessary effect on artwork originality or the inspiration-only role of the AI draft.
The main logo's strapline colour treatment does not determine or change the separate deliverable coverage for logo colour variants.
